method: Inspected all 83 active labelled shell blocks across 27 paths, including indented fences, and the surrounding consumer purpose; inspected 76 historical proposal blocks separately. Bash/PowerShell syntax checks executed for 41 concrete blocks; 42 authoring synopses are not unchanged programs. Additional unlabelled/text CLI-like blocks were inspected as synopsis. This is bounded embedded-shell coverage, not every prose claim or invoked implementation.
rule_applicability: CS-004/005/007/010/015/016/017/022/023/024/025/030 assessed where commands handle inputs, credentials, processes or results. Remaining naming, typing, import, callback, HTML/SQL, dependency and reuse rules apply to generated/current program bodies rather than a reference CLI synopsis; no blanket whole-file compliance inferred.

Installer/uninstaller commands pass fixed flags. User-selected placeholder paths are synopsis inputs; these commands intentionally mutate installation and are not assertions of successful installation.

Copilot initialization uses a fixed no-review prompt and empty tool allowance; session continuation restricts writes and requires actual session identifier. Finalize CLI examples are placeholders; underlying status and artifact admission are language-owner scope.
One-command placeholder is an evidence field, not an executable check or a default PASS. Standalone HITL template is separately repaired in DOC-004.

Panel preparation establishes max bytes and digest before runner calls; final aggregation uses expected digest. Angle-bracket arguments are explicit authoring synopsis, not runnable unchanged commands. Runner bounds and error propagation are audited in actual shell sources.

Risk/model selection invokes registered selector with candidates file; subsequent codex command is explicit synopsis with live model/effort inputs. No fixed model identity becomes an authorization substitute.

Inspected key creation and both canonical signing examples. DOC-003 removed signing key from child argv and validates environment/file precedence, normalization and missing-key failure with actual extracted program tests; PowerShell RNG uses instance API. Real token creation was not executed.

gh issue command is a human-filled synopsis with literal placeholder title/body, not a program substituting untrusted data into shell source. Publication requires the surrounding workflow approval; no issue sent during this audit.
